etymologies.etymologyHTML: From champion +‎ -ship.

definitions.definition: (sports) A competition to determine a champion, especially the final of a series of competitions.
The position of champion, or winner.
Defense or support of some cause.

quote.citation: 1943 November – 1944 February (date written; published 1945 August 17), George Orwell [pseudonym; Eric Arthur Blair], Animal Farm […], London: Secker & Warburg, published May 1962, →OCLC:
quote.text: They had also dropped their championship of Jones, who had given up hope of getting his farm back and gone to live in another part of the county.
